clarifications.text: Cell lines without RNA expression data (8 discovery, 4 holdout, among 24Q4 Avana lines) are excluded from context and test sets, since every method needs expression features. The pre-registration did not state this. Found when the first fit failed on missing values; no model results existed at the time (only 3 rows of the 'mean' reference method, which were deleted and rerun).
clarifications.effect: k = 626 becomes the 618 discovery lines with expression; the holdout test set has 413 lines.
